skillTypes.heading: Common and Special Skills in Infinity

descriptions.singular: An Automatic Skill can be employed without expending an Order or ARO.
descriptions.plural: Automatic Skills can be employed without expending an Order or ARO.

descriptions.singular: A Deployment Skill is used during the Deployment Phase or when a Trooper is deployed.
descriptions.plural: Deployment Skills are used during the Deployment Phase or when Troopers are deployed.

descriptions.singular: A Basic Short Skill expends one Basic Short Skill.
descriptions.plural: Basic Short Skills expend one Basic Short Skill.

descriptions.singular: A Short Skill expends one Short Skill.
descriptions.plural: Short Skills expend one Short Skill.

descriptions.singular: A Long Skill expends the entire Order and can only be declared in the Active Turn.
descriptions.plural: Long Skills expend the entire Order and can only be declared in the Active Turn.

descriptions.singular: An ARO Skill is one that a Trooper may perform as an ARO.
descriptions.plural: ARO Skills are those that Troopers may perform as an ARO.

labels.description: Encompasses Skills related to Airborne Infantry.

labels.name: Assignable (Transmutation)

labels.name: Attack
labels.description: The use of the Special Skill or Equipment is considered an Attack.

labels.name: CC Special Skill

labels.name: Comms Attack

labels.name: Comms Equipment
labels.description: Equipment vulnerable to certain Hacking Programs and Ammunition.

labels.name: Hackable
labels.description: A Trooper, Peripheral, weapon, or Equipment that can be targeted by certain Hacking Programs.

labels.name: Hostile
labels.description: A game element with its own Attributes that belongs to neither player's Army List.

labels.name: Optional
labels.description: The use of this Special Skill or Equipment is optional and can be waived.

labels.name: Marker
labels.description: This label indicates that a Trooper, weapon, or piece of equipment can be represented by a Marker.

labels.name: Movement

labels.name: Negative Feedback (NFB)
labels.description: The Skill or Equipment is incompatible with another element having the same Label or Trait.

labels.description: The Skill does not require Line of Fire to the target.

labels.name: Non-Reloadable
labels.description: An Unloaded State cannot be canceled and expended uses cannot be regained.

labels.name: No Roll

labels.name: Null
labels.description: A State with this Label does not provide an Order or Victory Points.

labels.name: Obligatory

labels.name: Private Information

labels.name: States Phase
labels.description: The Equipment or Skill can only be used during the States Phase unless stated otherwise.

labels.name: Superior Deployment
labels.description: Encompasses Skills that allow Troopers to deploy outside their Deployment Zone.

labels.name: Supportware
labels.description: Hacking Programs that provide support to Allied Troopers or interfere with enemies.

records.name: Camouflaged State
records.summary: A Marker State that hides the represented Trooper, Weapon, or Equipment until it is revealed by Discover or another rule.

effects: The represented game element is replaced by a Camouflaged Marker while the State is active.
A successful Discover Roll reveals the Marker and replaces it with the corresponding Model or Token.
A Camouflaged Marker may carry the user's Mimetism MOD and has 360-degree Line of Fire.
requirements: The game element has the Camouflage Special Skill.
restrictions: Enemy Troopers cannot declare Attacks against a Camouflaged Marker unless another rule allows it; the Marker must normally be Discovered first.
Enemy Troopers cannot enter Silhouette contact with a Camouflaged Marker.
A Trooper in Camouflaged State cannot be part of a Fireteam.
During the Active Turn, a Camouflage user may regain this State only with the required Long Skill while outside the LoF of enemy Models and Markers.

records.name: Camouflage
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill that lets its user deploy in and later enter Camouflaged State.

effects: During the Deployment Phase, the user may deploy in Camouflaged State.
During the game, the user may enter Camouflaged State under that State's activation conditions.

records.name: Discover
records.summary: A Common Skill used to reveal game elements represented by Markers.

requirements: The user must meet the target and visibility requirements for the Marker.
effects: The user makes the required WIP Roll to reveal an eligible Marker.
restrictions: The Marker State and other rules determine the Roll MODs and result.

records.name: Super-Jump
records.summary: A Special Skill that modifies Jump and can add a listed Unit Profile distance to a Jump.

effects: If Jump is declared as the first Basic Short Skill of the Order, Super-Jump turns Jump from a Long Skill into a Basic Short Skill and allows another compatible Basic Short or Short Skill in the same Order.
A Long Skill Jump uses the first MOV value plus 4 inches; when Super-Jump has a Unit Profile distance, a Short Skill Jump adds that distance instead of Jump's usual 2 inches.
restrictions: Jump can be declared as a Basic Short Skill only once per Order, and the user cannot benefit from Partial Cover MODs while declaring Jump.

records.name: Forward Deployment
records.summary: A Deployment Skill that allows deployment beyond the Deployment Zone by the distance listed in the Unit Profile.

requirements: The user must deploy during the Deployment Phase.
effects: The user may deploy beyond their Deployment Zone by the distance listed in the Unit Profile.
restrictions: The listed distance and all normal Deployment restrictions limit the placement.

records.name: Non-Reloadable

records.name: Perimeter

records.name: Prior Deployment
records.summary: Must be placed during the Deployment Phase.

records.name: Reflective

records.name: Silent (X)

records.name: Speculative Attack
records.summary: Can be used to make Speculative Attacks.

records.name: State
records.summary: Causes the target to enter the Game State indicated in its profile.

records.name: Suppressive Fire (SF)

records.name: Target (Attribute)

records.name: Targetless

records.name: Zone of Control (ZoC)

records.name: Doctor
records.summary: A Short Special Skill that restores VITA-based allies and can cancel applicable states.

requirements: The target must be a friendly VITA-based Trooper in Silhouette contact with the user.
effects: A successful WIP Roll restores a lost Wound or cancels an applicable State.
restrictions: The target's State and the Doctor rule determine whether the Roll is permitted and its result.

records.name: Engineer
records.summary: A Short Special Skill that repairs STR-based allies and cancels applicable states.

requirements: The target must be a friendly STR-based Trooper, piece of Equipment, or Scenery item in Silhouette contact with the user.
effects: A successful WIP Roll restores a lost Structure or cancels an applicable State.
restrictions: The target's State and the Engineer rule determine whether the Roll is permitted and its result.

records.name: Cyberplug
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill that grants access to Peripheral (Cyberplug) Troopers.

effects: The user has access to Peripheral (Cyberplug) Troopers as specified by the applicable profile.
restrictions: Peripheral (Cyberplug) rules and the profile's listed options govern the available Troopers.

records.name: Peripheral
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill defining common Controller/Peripheral behavior and the five core Peripheral types.

effects: The rule defines the Controller and Peripheral behavior for the applicable Peripheral type.
restrictions: The selected Peripheral type and its specific rules limit Controller and Peripheral actions.

records.name: Peripheral (Servant)
records.summary: A Peripheral type controlled by a Doctor or Engineer, with unlimited operating distance and a maximum of two per Controller.

records.name: Peripheral (Synchronized)
records.summary: A Peripheral type whose operation depends on its Controller and Coherency; the core type rule states no generic Controller-eligibility predicate.

records.name: Peripheral (Control)
records.summary: A Peripheral type with unlimited operating distance and a maximum of three per Controller; the core type rule states no generic Controller-eligibility predicate.

records.name: Peripheral (Ancillary)
records.summary: A Peripheral type with unlimited operating distance that starts undeployed; the core type rule states no generic Controller-eligibility predicate.

records.name: Peripheral (Cyberplug)
records.summary: A Peripheral type granted by Cyberplug, with unlimited operating distance, a maximum of two per Controller, and Connected/Autonomous operating profiles.

records.name: Regular
records.summary: The Trooper contributes its Regular Order to the appropriate Combat Group Order Pool under normal conditions.

records.name: Irregular
records.summary: The Trooper generates an Irregular Order that remains separate from the Combat Group Regular Order Pool.

records.name: Martial Arts
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill with discrete Levels; the exact Level listed for a Trooper determines the applicable Level effects.

requirements: The user must reach or be in Silhouette contact with the target and declare CC Attack.
effects: The Martial Arts Level listed in the Unit Profile supplies its defined Attack, Opponent, and Burst MODs for that Close Combat.
restrictions: Only the exact Level listed for the user applies.

records.name: Martial Arts L1
records.summary: The Level 1 source variant of Martial Arts. Levels are discrete rather than cumulative, so this occurrence identifies Level 1 specifically.

records.name: Martial Arts L2
records.summary: The Level 2 source variant of Martial Arts. Levels are discrete rather than cumulative, so this occurrence identifies Level 2 specifically.

records.name: Martial Arts L3
records.summary: The Level 3 source variant of Martial Arts. Levels are discrete rather than cumulative, so this occurrence identifies Level 3 specifically.

records.name: Martial Arts L4
records.summary: The Level 4 source variant of Martial Arts. Levels are discrete rather than cumulative, so this occurrence identifies Level 4 specifically.

records.name: Martial Arts L5
records.summary: The Level 5 source variant of Martial Arts. Levels are discrete rather than cumulative, so this occurrence identifies Level 5 specifically.

records.name: Strategos
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill with discrete Levels; the exact Level listed for a Trooper determines the applicable Strategos effects.

requirements: The user must be the army's Lieutenant.
effects: The Strategos Level listed in the Unit Profile supplies its defined Deployment Phase and Order Count effects; Level 2 also supplies its Tactical Phase Combat Group transfer effect.
restrictions: Only the exact Level listed for the user applies.

records.name: Strategos L1
records.summary: The Level 1 source variant of Strategos. Levels are discrete rather than cumulative, so this occurrence identifies Level 1 specifically.

records.name: Strategos L2
records.summary: The Level 2 source variant of Strategos. Levels are discrete rather than cumulative, so this occurrence identifies Level 2 specifically.

records.name: BS Attack
records.summary: A Common Skill used to make BS Attacks; exact source variants may replace the user's BS Attribute with a listed value for this Skill.

requirements: The user must select an eligible BS Weapon, Equipment item, or Skill and meet its targeting requirements.
effects: The user makes the attack using the selected item's profile and applicable Attributes, Burst, Ammunition, and MODs.
restrictions: The selected item's range, Line of Fire, target, and special rules limit the attack.

records.name: BS=12
records.summary: The BS=12 exact source variant of BS Attack. When using this Skill, the user replaces their BS Attribute with 12.

records.name: BS=11
records.summary: The BS=11 exact source variant of BS Attack. When using this Skill, the user replaces their BS Attribute with 11.

records.name: CC Attack
records.summary: A Common Skill used to make CC Attacks; an exact source variant may replace the user's CC Attribute with a listed value for this Skill.

requirements: The user must be in Silhouette contact with the target and select an eligible CC Weapon or rule.
effects: The user makes the attack using the selected item's profile and applicable CC, Ammunition, and MODs.
restrictions: The selected item's effects and close-combat rules limit the attack.

records.name: CC=21
records.summary: The CC=21 exact source variant of CC Attack. When using this Skill, the user replaces their CC Attribute with 21.

records.name: Cube
records.summary: Automatic Equipment represented by a Unit Profile symbol that allows Command Token rerolls when Doctor or another recovery rule explicitly permits Cube rerolls.

effects: When Doctor or another Special Skill or piece of Equipment explicitly permits it, a Command Token may be spent to reroll the failed recovery Roll for a Trooper with a Cube.

records.name: Cube 2.0
records.summary: Automatic Equipment represented by a Unit Profile symbol that includes Cube recovery rerolls and improves Saving Rolls against Sepsitor attacks.

effects: When Doctor or another Special Skill or piece of Equipment explicitly permits it, a Command Token may be spent to reroll the failed recovery Roll for a Trooper with a Cube 2.0.
The user applies a +2 MOD to Saving Rolls against Sepsitor and Sepsitor Plus attacks.

records.name: TinBot
records.summary: Automatic Equipment that grants its owner the MOD, Special Skill, or Equipment advantage specified by the exact TinBot source variant.

records.name: TinBot: Firewall
records.summary: The Firewall named source variant of TinBot. Its exact source identity remains distinct from occurrence-specific modifier values.

records.name: TinBot: Neurocinetics
records.summary: The Neurocinetics named source variant of TinBot. Its exact source identity remains distinct from occurrence-specific modifier values.

records.name: TinBot: Albedo
records.summary: The Albedo named source variant of TinBot. Its exact source identity remains distinct from occurrence-specific modifier values.

records.name: TinBot: Discover
records.summary: The Discover named source variant of TinBot. Its exact source identity remains distinct from occurrence-specific modifier values.

records.name: TinBot: ECM Guided
records.summary: The ECM Guided named source variant of TinBot. Its exact source identity remains distinct from occurrence-specific modifier values.

records.name: TinBot: Repeater
records.summary: The Repeater named source variant of TinBot. Its exact source identity remains distinct from occurrence-specific modifier values.

records.name: Mimetism
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill that imposes its listed negative MOD on enemy BS Attacks requiring LoF and on Discover attempts against the user.

effects: Enemy BS Attacks that require LoF and Discover attempts against the user apply the Mimetism MOD listed in the Unit Profile.
The Mimetism MOD does not apply to CC Attacks.
restrictions: Only the Mimetism MOD listed in the user's Unit Profile applies.

records.name: Multispectral Visor
records.summary: Automatic Equipment whose Level reduces Mimetism and Visibility Zone MODs, with higher Levels improving visibility handling and Level 3 adding further camouflage-countering effects.

effects: Level 1 reduces Mimetism (-3) to 0 and Mimetism (-6) to -3.
Levels 2 and 3 reduce Mimetism MODs to 0.
All Levels interact with Visibility Zones and Smoke; Levels 2 and 3 remove Visibility Zone MODs while drawing LoF through those Zones.

Level 3 additionally improves Discover against Camouflaged targets, ignores specified Surprise Attack MODs, and can BS Attack a Camouflage Marker in LoF without first succeeding at Discover during the Active Turn; the Marker’s Mimetism MOD still applies to that attack.

records.name: Combat Instinct
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill that ignores Surprise Attack MODs and makes enemy Stealth ineffective against the user.

effects: The user ignores Surprise Attack MODs imposed by attackers.
Stealth is not effective against the user.
restrictions: The Skill affects only Surprise Attack MODs and Stealth; other MODs and ARO conditions still apply.

records.name: Sixth Sense
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill that improves reactions to attacks from outside LoF and makes enemy Stealth ineffective against the user.

effects: The user can respond to Attacks directed at them from outside LoF, using a 360° LoF arc for those attackers; this also allows LoF to outside attackers while Engaged.
When targeted by a BS Attack through a Zero Visibility Zone, the user ignores the -6 MOD caused by the resulting Poor Visibility Zone.
Dodge and Reset ignore negative MODs except the specified Immobilized-A, Immobilized-B, and Isolated State penalties.
Stealth is not effective against the user.
restrictions: The Skill's response and MOD exceptions apply only in the situations it specifies.

records.name: Stealth
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill that limits ARO generation for movement and idle actions when enemies lack LoF.

requirements: The user must be in the Active Turn.
effects: The user may declare Cautious Movement inside enemy Zones of Control and Hacking Areas.
Cautious Movement, Idle, and Basic Short Skills with the Movement Label grant AROs only to enemies that have LoF to the user.
Other declared Skills grant AROs normally.
If the user enters Silhouette contact without entering the enemy's LoF and then declares another Skill, that enemy's available AROs are restricted to the options allowed by the Stealth rule.
restrictions: Stealth does not prevent AROs when an enemy has LoF to the user or when the user declares another Skill.

records.name: Surprise Attack
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill that imposes its listed negative MOD on targets' Face to Face ARO Rolls when attacking from Marker form or Hidden Deployment.

requirements: The user must begin the Order in Marker form or Hidden Deployment.
The user must declare a CC Attack, BS Attack, or Comms Attack during the Active Turn.
effects: The Attack imposes the negative Surprise Attack MOD shown in the Unit Profile on Face to Face Rolls made in ARO by targets of that Attack.
If the profile names a specific Attribute, the MOD applies only to that Attribute and does not stack with another Surprise Attack MOD.
restrictions: After use, Surprise Attack cannot be used again until the Trooper returns to Marker form.

records.name: Hidden Deployment State
records.summary: A deployment state in which a Trooper's position is recorded privately without placing a Model or Marker on the table.

effects: The Trooper is not placed on the table while the state is active and is generally treated as not being on the table.
The state is canceled when the Trooper is Discovered by a rule that explicitly allows it, such as Sensor.
requirements: The Trooper has the Hidden Deployment Special Skill.
restrictions: Once canceled, Hidden Deployment State cannot be regained.

records.name: Hidden Deployment
records.summary: An optional Deployment Special Skill that lets the user deploy in Hidden Deployment State.

effects: During the Deployment Phase, the user may deploy in Hidden Deployment State.

records.name: Sensor
records.summary: A Short Special Skill that detects hidden threats in the user's Zone of Control and improves Discover against Camouflage.

effects: The user may make a Normal WIP+6 Roll to simultaneously Discover enemy Troopers, Weapons, or Equipment in Hidden Deployment or Camouflaged State inside the user's Zone of Control.
The Sensor Roll does not apply Range or Mimetism MODs and does not require LoF or a designated target.
Enemies with the Camouflage Special Skill cannot regain Camouflaged State inside the user's Zone of Control.
The user gains +6 WIP when declaring Discover against Camouflage Markers.

records.name: Marksmanship
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill used with BS Attacks that ignores negative BS MODs from Partial Cover and Nanoscreen.

requirements: The user can benefit from Marksmanship only when declaring a BS Attack.
effects: The user may ignore negative BS MODs imposed by Partial Cover and Nanoscreen.
restrictions: Only the negative BS MODs from Partial Cover and Nanoscreen are ignored.

records.name: Baggage
records.summary: Automatic Equipment that lets nearby Allied Troopers reload eligible Disposable items and recover from Unloaded State.

requirements: The Baggage holder and the affected Allied Trooper must both be in non-Null States, and the affected Allied Trooper must be inside the Baggage holder's Zone of Control.
effects: The affected Trooper may use Reload to cancel Unloaded State or regain all expended uses of eligible Disposable Weapons or Equipment.
During the States Phase, each eligible Allied Trooper in range may automatically receive the same recovery.
restrictions: Only one Allied Trooper can receive the Reload effect per Order.
Non-Reloadable items cannot regain uses or cancel their Unloaded State through this effect.
Recovering uses does not affect items already deployed on the table.

records.name: Albedo
records.summary: Automatic Equipment whose listed negative MOD affects enemy Multispectral Visor or Marksmanship users attacking or Discovering the bearer.

effects: An enemy with a Multispectral Visor or Marksmanship that declares a LoF-requiring BS Attack or Discover against the bearer applies the listed Albedo negative MOD to the relevant Attribute.
The Albedo MOD does not apply to CC Attacks.

records.name: Natural Born Warrior
records.summary: An Automatic CC Special Skill that lets the user ignore negative MODs imposed by the opposing Trooper during a CC Face to Face Roll.

requirements: The user must be the target of a CC Attack and must declare a CC Attack.
effects: In the resulting CC Face to Face Roll, the user ignores all negative MODs imposed by the opposing Trooper.
restrictions: The effect applies only to negative MODs imposed by the opposing Trooper in that CC Face to Face Roll.

records.name: Limited Cover
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill that removes the target's -3 BS MOD for Partial Cover while leaving other applicable Cover effects intact.

effects: Attacks against the Trooper do not apply the -3 BS MOD granted by Partial Cover.
restrictions: Other applicable Partial Cover effects remain in force.

records.name: Non-Hackable
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill that prevents Unit-Type-dependent Hacking Attacks from targeting the user.

effects: The user cannot be targeted by Hacking Attacks whose Requirements depend on the target having a specific Unit Type.
The Skill remains active while the user is in a Null State.
restrictions: The protection applies to Hacking Attacks whose Requirements specify a Unit Type; it does not create a general immunity to every Hacking effect.

records.name: No Cover
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill that prevents the Trooper from benefiting from any MODs granted by Partial Cover.

effects: The Trooper cannot benefit from any MODs granted by Partial Cover.
When No Cover and Limited Cover both apply, the more severe No Cover restriction takes precedence.
restrictions: The restriction applies only to MODs granted by Partial Cover.

records.name: Forward Observer
records.summary: A Special Skill that makes a WIP-based BS Attack and places a successfully affected target in Targeted State.

requirements: The user must be able to draw LoF to the target.
effects: Forward Observer is a BS Attack using a BS Weapon (WIP); instead of forcing a Saving Roll, a successful attack causes the target to enter Targeted State.

records.name: Dodge
records.summary: A Common Skill used to evade Attacks, reposition slightly, and cancel Engaged or Immobilized-A State on a successful PH Roll.

requirements: The user must be the Active Trooper or be allowed to declare an ARO.
effects: Dodge uses PH to evade enemy Attacks during the Order or ARO; a successful Dodge may also move the user up to 2 inches.
A successful Normal or Face to Face Dodge Roll cancels the user's Immobilized-A State, applying any State-specific MODs.
restrictions: Dodge does not evade Comms Attacks; Reset is used for those instead.

records.name: Reset
records.summary: A Common Skill used to oppose Comms Attacks and Guided attacks and to cancel Targeted, Immobilized-B, or Isolated State.

requirements: The user must be the Active Trooper or be allowed to declare an ARO.
effects: Reset uses WIP to oppose enemy Comms Attacks and BS Attacks (Guided); otherwise it is a Normal WIP Roll.
A successful Reset Roll cancels the user's Targeted, Immobilized-B, or Isolated State, applying any State-specific MODs.
restrictions: Reset does not evade other types of Attacks; Dodge is used for those instead.

records.name: Cautious Movement
records.summary: A Long Common Skill that can move a Trooper without generating enemy AROs when its start and end positions satisfy the rule's visibility and proximity limits.

effects: The Trooper may move up to the first MOV value without generating enemy AROs when the movement begins and ends outside the required enemy LoF, Zone of Control, and applicable Hacking Areas.
restrictions: TAGs, Remotes, Vehicles, Troopers with Motorcycles, Troopers with Aerial, and Troopers in Targeted State cannot declare Cautious Movement.

records.name: Alert
records.summary: An Automatic Common Skill that lets an eligible Trooper turn at the end of an Order after a nearby Attack.

requirements: The user or an Allied Trooper in its Zone of Control was the target of an Attack.
The user has not activated in the same Order.
effects: At the end of the Order, the user may turn on the spot without changing position or generating AROs.

records.name: Climb
records.summary: A Long Common Skill used to move on vertical surfaces.

requirements: The user must be in base contact with a vertical surface.
At least half of the user's base must remain in contact with the surface while moving.
The movement must finish on a surface at least as large as the base.
effects: The user moves on the vertical surface up to its first MOV value plus 2 inches; a Climb distance listed in the Unit Profile replaces the 2-inch bonus.
restrictions: Climb only permits movement on vertical surfaces and follows the General Movement Rules.
While holding onto a vertical surface, the Trooper cannot declare Skills other than Climb.
A Trooper performing Climb or holding onto a vertical surface cannot benefit from Partial Cover MODs.

records.name: Idle
records.summary: A Common Skill that spends the declared action without another effect.

effects: The user performs no action, although the declaration still activates the Trooper and may generate AROs.
A declared Skill whose Requirements are not met is resolved as Idle instead.

records.name: Intuitive Attack
records.summary: A Long Common Skill that uses a BS Weapon with the Intuitive Attack Trait against a target that normally cannot be attacked directly.

requirements: The user must employ a BS Weapon with the Intuitive Attack Trait.
The target must be outside the user's LoF because of a Zero Visibility Zone, or be in a State that normally requires Discover before it can be attacked.
effects: The user makes an unmodified WIP Roll; on success, the user performs a single BS Attack Roll against the target with Burst 1.
restrictions: MODs from Partial Cover, Special Skills, Equipment, and other sources do not apply to the required WIP Roll.
After a failed WIP Roll, the user cannot attempt another Intuitive Attack against the same target until the next Active Turn.

records.name: Jump
records.summary: A Long Common Skill used to clear obstacles and move through the air.

requirements: The user must be able to reach a horizontal landing surface at least as large as its base.
effects: The user may Jump up to its first MOV value plus 2 inches; a Jump distance listed in the Unit Profile replaces the 2-inch bonus.
Declaring Jump automatically cancels Prone State.
restrictions: The trajectory and landing must follow the Jump and General Movement Rules.
The user cannot benefit from Partial Cover MODs during an Order in which it declared Jump.

records.name: Move
records.summary: A Common Skill used to move a Trooper up to its applicable MOV value.

effects: The user moves up to the applicable MOV value.
restrictions: Movement must follow the general movement rules.

records.name: Look Out
records.summary: An ARO Common Skill that lets the user warn other Troopers so they can turn to face an acting enemy.

requirements: The user must have LoF to an enemy Trooper or Marker that declares or performs an Order.
effects: Other Troopers of the same player may modify their LoF by making Dodge (PH-3) Rolls in the same Order.
restrictions: An alerted Trooper may make the Dodge (PH-3) Roll only if it has not declared another ARO.

records.name: Place Deployable
records.summary: A Common Skill used to place eligible Deployable Weapons, Equipment, or Peripheral (Ancillary) items on the table.

requirements: The user must have a Weapon or Equipment item with the Deployable Label, or a Peripheral (Ancillary).
In the Reactive Turn, the user must have LoF to the Active Trooper.
effects: The user places one eligible Token or Model without a Roll; it becomes active at the Conclusion of the Order.
restrictions: Placement must follow the active/reactive placement, support, and Deployment restrictions of Place Deployable.
A Deployable Weapon cannot be placed with an enemy Camouflaged Marker inside its Trigger Area unless the documented exception applies.

records.name: Reload
records.summary: A Common Skill that cancels Unloaded State or restores expended Disposable uses when its requirements are met.

requirements: The user and the Allied Trooper or game element with Baggage must both be in non-Null States, and the user must be inside that Baggage holder's Zone of Control.
The user is in Unloaded State or has expended uses of a Disposable Weapon or piece of Equipment.
effects: Without a Roll, the user cancels Unloaded State or regains all expended uses of eligible Disposable Weapons or Equipment.
restrictions: Only one Allied Trooper can receive this effect per Order.
Recovering Disposable uses does not affect Weapons or Equipment already deployed on the table.
Non-Reloadable Weapons or Equipment cannot cancel Unloaded State or regain expended uses through Reload.

records.name: Request Speedball
records.summary: An Automatic Common Skill that calls airborne support by placing two Speedball Tokens.

requirements: The player must have two Speedball Tokens.
effects: During the Active Turn, place two 55 mm Speedball Tokens using the Combat Jump rules and make a PH 15 Roll for each token.
restrictions: Request Speedball cannot be performed partway through the Order Expenditure Sequence.

records.name: Speculative Attack
records.summary: A Long Common Skill that uses a BS Weapon with the Speculative Attack Trait to attack without LoF.

requirements: The user must employ a BS Weapon with the Speculative Attack Trait.
A valid trajectory must exist between the user and the chosen impact point.
effects: The user makes a single BS Attack with Burst 1 against a target outside LoF; eligible Circular Templates may use a separate impact point that still affects the Main Target.
restrictions: Apply the Speculative Attack -6 MOD and Range MODs; other negative MODs such as Mimetism, Partial Cover, and Visibility Zones are not applied.
A Circular Template impact point cannot be placed on a vertical surface or in the air.

records.name: Suppressive Fire
records.summary: A Long Common Skill that places the user in Suppressive Fire State with a selected weapon.

requirements: The user must select a Weapon with the Suppressive Fire Trait.
effects: The user enters Suppressive Fire State using the selected Weapon.

records.name: Unconscious State
records.summary: A Null State entered when a Trooper has received as many Wounds as its VITA or STR Attribute.

effects: The Trooper cannot declare Orders or AROs and does not contribute an Order during the Tactical Phase.
Automatic Special Skills and Automatic Equipment have no effect while the state is active.
Removing a Wound so the Trooper has fewer Wounds than its VITA or STR value cancels the state.

records.name: Disconnected State
records.summary: A Null State in which a Peripheral cannot activate while separated from or disabled through its Controller relationship.

effects: The Peripheral cannot be activated or declare Orders or AROs.
Automatic Special Skills and Automatic Equipment have no effect except for the Peripheral Special Skill.
Engineer can cancel the state when it was caused directly by an Attack, scenery, or a Scenario Special Rule.

records.name: Immobilized-A State
records.summary: A restrictive State that normally limits the Trooper to Dodge at PH -6.

effects: The Trooper cannot declare Skills or AROs except Dodge, applying a -6 PH MOD.
A successful qualifying Dodge or an Engineer WIP Roll can cancel the state.

records.name: Immobilized-B State
records.summary: A restrictive State that normally limits the Trooper to Reset at WIP -3.

effects: The Trooper cannot declare Skills, Attacks, or AROs except Reset, applying a -3 WIP MOD.
A successful qualifying Reset or an Engineer WIP Roll can cancel the state.

records.name: Isolated State
records.summary: A State that cuts a Trooper off from its Order Pool and disables its Comms-related capabilities.

effects: The Trooper cannot receive Orders from its Order Pool and becomes Irregular in following Active Turns while still Isolated.
Comms Attack and Comms Equipment capabilities, including Hacking Programs, are disabled.
Reset is made at WIP -9; a successful qualifying Reset or Engineer WIP Roll can cancel the state.
restrictions: An Isolated Trooper cannot be part of a Fireteam or take part in a Coordinated Order.

records.name: Stunned State
records.summary: A temporary State that prevents Attacks and applies a -3 MOD to most Rolls.

effects: The Trooper cannot declare Attacks and applies a -3 MOD to Rolls other than Saving Rolls.
Doctor can cancel the state for VITA targets and Engineer can cancel it for STR targets.
The state also cancels automatically at the start of the States Phase of the Player Turn in which it was caused.

records.name: Targeted State
records.summary: A State that makes the Trooper easier to attack or Discover and interferes with Reset, Cautious Movement, and Stealth.

effects: BS Attack, Comms Attack, and Discover against the Trooper gain a +3 MOD to the Attribute used.
The Trooper applies a -3 WIP MOD to Reset.
A successful qualifying Reset or an Engineer WIP Roll can cancel the state.
restrictions: The Trooper cannot declare Cautious Movement or use the Stealth Special Skill.

records.name: Unloaded State
records.summary: An item-specific State entered when a Disposable Weapon or Equipment item exhausts its uses or ammunition.

effects: The relevant Weapon or Equipment item cannot be used while Unloaded State is active.
Reloading cancels the state and restores the item's uses unless a rule such as Non-Reloadable says otherwise.

records.name: 360º Visor
records.summary: Automatic Equipment that expands the user's Line of Fire arc to 360º instead of the usual 180º.

effects: The user has a 360º LoF arc instead of the usual 180º arc.

records.name: Nanoscreen
records.summary: Automatic Equipment that protects its user against eligible BS Attacks by penalizing the attacker and improving the user's Saving Rolls.

requirements: The user must be the target of a BS Attack.
effects: A -3 BS MOD is imposed on BS Attack Rolls against the user.
+3 applies to the user's Saving Rolls against those BS Attacks.
restrictions: The MODs do not apply to BS Attacks with the Comms. Attack Trait.
Nanoscreen cannot be used against CC Attacks.

records.name: X-Visor
records.summary: Automatic Equipment that improves the user's negative Range MODs for ranged attacks and other Range-band actions.

effects: For the user's BS Weapons, Special Skills, and Equipment, a -3 Range MOD becomes 0 and a -6 Range MOD becomes -3.
The same benefit applies to Common Skills with Range bands, including Discover and Suppressive Fire.

records.name: Biometric Visor
records.summary: Automatic Equipment that counters Impersonation penalties and qualifying Surprise Attack MODs.

effects: The user ignores the WIP -3 MOD imposed by Impersonation-1 State.
A successful Discover Roll against a Trooper in Impersonation-1 State cancels that Impersonation State.
The user ignores Surprise Attack MODs from attackers benefiting from Impersonation or Holoecho States when the rule conditions are met.
restrictions: The Surprise Attack protection is conditional on the attacker benefiting from Impersonation or Holoecho State; LoF is normally required, except against qualifying CC Attacks.

records.name: Dazer
records.summary: Deployable Equipment that creates a Difficult Terrain area inside its Zone of Control.

effects: A deployed Dazer generates a Difficult Terrain area of infinite height inside its Zone of Control.
Troopers with Terrain (Total) ignore the Dazer and apply their Terrain MOD when declaring Skills with the Movement Label.
A deployed Dazer remains on the table until the end of the game or until destroyed.

records.name: Deactivator
records.summary: A Short Skill Equipment action that removes enemy deployed Weapons or Equipment after a successful WIP Roll.

requirements: The target must be inside the user's Line of Fire or Zone of Control.
The target must be an enemy Deployable Weapon or deployed piece of Equipment, and cannot be a Camouflage Marker.
effects: On a successful Normal WIP Roll, the target deployed Weapon or Equipment is removed from the game table.
restrictions: The WIP Roll applies Range MODs only; Special Skill MODs such as Mimetism and Cover MODs are not applied.
Passing the Roll does not prevent the target from triggering during the current Order.

records.name: Deployable Cover
records.summary: Deployable Equipment that places a Scenery Element providing variant-specific Cover effects.

effects: Place Deployable places the Deployable Cover Scenery Element completely inside the user's Zone of Control.
Deployable Cover allows Partial Cover to be applied subject to the selected variant.
Cutting Foam prevents enemy Troopers from claiming Partial Cover from that Deployable Cover.
Vitroferro removes the usual -3 Cover MOD from the attacker's BS Attack Roll and instead improves the benefiting Trooper's Saving Roll by +6, subject to the documented cap.
restrictions: The player must declare the available Cutting Foam or Vitroferro variant when Place Deployable is declared.

records.name: Repeater
records.summary: Automatic Comms Equipment that extends allied Hacking Areas and can also be used by enemy Hackers with Firewall MODs.

effects: The Repeater extends the Hacking Area of all Hackers in the same Army List.
Enemy Hackers inside its Zone of Control may use the Repeater to apply Hacking Programs against enemy Hackers, applying the documented Firewall MODs.
restrictions: The owner cannot voluntarily deactivate the Repeater; it becomes inactive when its carrier is Isolated or in a Null State.

records.name: Deployable Repeater
records.summary: Deployable Comms Equipment that places a Repeater on the battlefield using Place Deployable.

effects: Place Deployable places a Deployable Repeater Token on the game table.
The deployed Equipment contains a Repeater and applies the Repeater rule while active.

records.name: FastPanda
records.summary: Self-propelled Deployable Equipment that places a Repeater anywhere completely inside the user's Zone of Control.

effects: When Place Deployable is declared, the FastPanda may be placed completely inside the user's Zone of Control instead of in Silhouette contact.
The deployed FastPanda contains a Repeater and applies the Repeater rule while active.
The deployed FastPanda remains on the table until the end of the game or until destroyed.

records.name: AI Motorcycle
records.summary: Automatic Equipment that uses Motorcycle rules while mounted and becomes a Peripheral (Synchronized) when the rider dismounts.

effects: The mounted profile applies the Motorcycle Equipment rules.
The dismounted profile applies Peripheral (Synchronized) to the AI Motorcycle and uses Transmutation (Auto) to change between mounted and dismounted profiles.
restrictions: The Trooper cannot return to the mounted profile while the Peripheral is Isolated, Immobilized, or in a Null State.
Supportware affecting the Peripheral is canceled for the Trooper when the mounted profile is applied.

records.name: Bangbomb
records.summary: Optional Automatic Equipment that applies its listed positive MOD to eligible Dodge Rolls against nearby enemy attacks.

requirements: The user declares Dodge.
effects: Apply the MOD listed after Bangbomb in the Unit Profile to eligible Dodge Rolls.
restrictions: The MOD only applies against attacks declared by enemy Troopers inside the user’s LoF or Zone of Control.
The MOD does not apply against Template Weapon attacks.

records.name: ECM
records.summary: Automatic Equipment that imposes the listed negative MOD on enemy attacks of the type specified in the bearer’s Unit Profile.

requirements: The owner is the target of the Attack type listed in brackets after ECM in the Unit Profile.
effects: The Enemy applies the listed negative ECM MOD when attempting that Attack against the owner.

records.name: Escape System
records.summary: Army Equipment identity whose game effect is defined by the Transmutation (Escape System-X) rules for changing to the alternate Unit Profile.

effects: When the Escape System threshold is reached, the Trooper changes to the alternate Unit Profile under Transmutation (Escape System-X).
The profile change places an Eclipse Special Ammo Circular Template centered on the replacement Model.
restrictions: The threshold is the value listed after Escape System in the source profile.

records.name: EVO Hacking Device
records.summary: Automatic Comms Equipment that grants access to the EVO support Hacking Programs.

effects: Allows the use of Assisted Fire, Controlled Jump, Enhanced Reaction, and Fairy Dust Hacking Programs.

records.name: GizmoKit
records.summary: Short-Skill Equipment that repairs allied Models with STR by removing a Wound on a successful target PH Roll.

requirements: The target is an Allied Model with the STR Attribute.
Remote use requires LoF; contact use requires Silhouette contact.
effects: Remote use is a Non-Lethal BS Weapon; contact use spends a Short Skill without an attack Roll.
On a successful target PH Roll, remove one Wound and cancel Unconscious State if applicable.
On a failed target PH Roll, the target receives a Wound instead.

records.name: Hacking Device
records.summary: Automatic Comms Equipment that grants access to the standard offensive and control Hacking Programs.

effects: Allows the use of Carbonite, Oblivion, Spotlight, and Total Control Hacking Programs.

records.name: Hacking Device Plus
records.summary: Automatic Comms Equipment that expands the standard Hacking Device program set with Cybermask and White Noise.

effects: Allows the use of Carbonite, Cybermask, Oblivion, Spotlight, Total Control, and White Noise Hacking Programs.

records.name: Holomask
records.summary: Optional Automatic Equipment that lets its user deploy in or enter HoloMask State.

effects: During Deployment, the user may deploy in HoloMask State.
During the game, the user may enter HoloMask State.

records.name: Holoprojector
records.summary: Optional NFB Automatic Equipment that lets its user deploy in or enter Holoecho State.

effects: When placed on the table, the bearer may deploy in Holoecho State.
During the game, the user may enter Holoecho State.

records.name: Killer Hacking Device
records.summary: Automatic Comms Equipment specialized for Cybermask and Trinity Hacking Programs.

effects: Allows the use of Cybermask and Trinity Hacking Programs.

records.name: MediKit
records.summary: Short-Skill Equipment that can recover allied Models with VITA from Unconscious State through a target PH Roll.

requirements: The target is an Allied Model with the VITA Attribute in Unconscious State, unless a scenario rule says otherwise.
Remote use requires LoF; contact use requires Silhouette contact.
effects: Remote use is a Non-Lethal BS Weapon; contact use spends a Short Skill without an attack Roll.
On a successful target PH Roll, remove one Wound and cancel Unconscious State.
On a failed target PH Roll, the target enters Dead State.

records.name: Motorcycle
records.summary: Automatic Equipment whose mounted movement rules restrict Climb, Cautious Movement, upward Jump movement, and entry into Prone State.

restrictions: A mounted Trooper cannot enter Prone State.
A mounted Trooper cannot declare Climb or use ladders.
A mounted Trooper cannot Jump vertically or diagonally upward; horizontal and downward Jump movement remains allowed.
A mounted Trooper cannot declare Cautious Movement.

records.name: SymbioMate
records.summary: Single-use assignable Equipment that temporarily replaces the user’s ARM and BTS with 9 and grants Immunity (Enhanced) for eligible Saving Rolls.

requirements: The SymbioMate must be used when its assigned user is forced to make a Saving Roll.
effects: For ARM/BTS Saving Rolls during the Order, use ARM/BTS 9 and apply Immunity (Enhanced) when applicable.
Against Comms Attacks, ARM/BTS 9 applies but Immunity (Enhanced) does not.
Remove the SymbioMate at the end of the Order in which it is used.

records.name: Combat Jump
records.summary: A Long Special Skill that keeps the user off-table until they attempt an airborne landing during their Active Turn.

effects: The user may remain off-table after Deployment and later spend their own Order to enter the table.
The user is placed on a valid horizontal landing surface and makes the Combat Jump PH Roll; a successful Roll keeps that position.
A failed landing moves the user to the player's Deployment Zone edge and removes any Deployables placed with the attempted landing.
Combat Jump (Explosion) adds a single-use PS 8 Normal Direct Template Attack after the landing position is resolved.
restrictions: The landing cannot place the user Prone, in prohibited Silhouette contact, inside enclosed scenery, or in contact with a scenario objective.
The user cannot benefit from Partial Cover during the Order in which Combat Jump is used.

records.name: Decoy
records.summary: A Deployment Skill that lets the user deploy with false replicas represented through Decoy State.

effects: When placed on the table, the user may deploy in Decoy State.
The value shown with Decoy determines whether one or two replica Decoys may be placed.

records.name: Impersonation
records.summary: A Deployment Skill that lets the user deploy forward while disguised in an Impersonation Marker State.

effects: The user may deploy outside the enemy Deployment Zone in Impersonation-1 State.
The user may attempt a WIP Roll to deploy inside the enemy Deployment Zone.
A profile with Impersonation (IMP-2) deploys and activates only Impersonation-2 State.
restrictions: A failed WIP Roll places the user in their own Deployment Zone at the table edge as a Model and removes Deployables placed with the attempt.
The user cannot deploy in prohibited contact with enemy or neutral game elements or mission objectives.

records.name: Infiltration
records.summary: A Deployment Skill that allows forward deployment in the user's half and a PH-based attempt to deploy into the opponent's half.

effects: During Deployment, the user may deploy anywhere in the player's half of the table.
Deploying in the opponent's half requires the Infiltration Roll, normally PH-3, with any profile-specific PH replacement applied as stated.
If the Roll fails, the user is moved to their own Deployment Zone edge and Deployables placed with the attempt are removed.
restrictions: Infiltration cannot be used to deploy inside the enemy Deployment Zone.
After a failed Infiltration Roll, the attempted deployment cannot remain in Marker or Hidden Deployment State.

records.name: Minelayer
records.summary: A Deployment Skill that lets the user place carried Deployable Weapons or Equipment near their deployment position.

requirements: The Deployable must satisfy the normal Deployment conditions and remain within the area where the Minelayer user may deploy.
Its Trigger Area or Perimeter area must satisfy the rule's enemy-presence restrictions when placed.
effects: When the user deploys, they may place the allowed number of carried Deployable Weapons or Equipment inside their Zone of Control.
Placing an item with the Disposable Trait consumes the corresponding available use.
If the user's Superior Deployment Roll fails, a Minelayer item placed with that deployment is removed and any Disposable use is consumed.

records.name: Parachutist
records.summary: A Long Special Skill that keeps the user off-table until they enter from a valid table-edge position during their Active Turn.

effects: The user may remain off-table after Deployment and later spend their own Order to enter the table.
The entry point must be on a surface large enough for the base and in contact with the table edge.
Parachutist (Deployment Zone) permits entry within the enemy Deployment Zone.
restrictions: Without the Deployment Zone variant, the user cannot enter inside the enemy Deployment Zone.
The entry cannot place the user Prone or in prohibited contact with enemy or neutral game elements or mission objectives.
The user cannot benefit from Partial Cover during the Order in which Parachutist is used.

records.name: Sapper
records.summary: A Deployment/Long Special Skill that lets its user begin or later enter Foxhole State.

requirements: The space used to enter Foxhole State must accommodate that State's Silhouette.
effects: During Deployment, the user may begin in Foxhole State.
During the Active Turn, the user may spend a Long Skill to enter Foxhole State.
restrictions: If the required space is unavailable, the attempted Active-Turn use becomes Idle instead.

records.name: Strategic Deployment
records.summary: A Deployment Skill that grants Forward Deployment to its user and the rest of that user's Fireteam during deployment.

requirements: The user must be the first Fireteam member deployed and must deploy as that Fireteam's Team Leader.
effects: The user and the rest of their Fireteam deploy as if they had Forward Deployment (+4 inches).
If a scenario or tournament rule already grants Forward Deployment (+4 inches) to a Fireteam member, the Fireteam instead applies Forward Deployment (+8 inches).

records.name: Decoy State
records.summary: A deployment Marker State that conceals which of several colocated replicas represents the real user.

effects: The user deploys with one or two replica Decoys in Coherency, according to the Decoy value.
The controlling player secretly records which representation is the real user.
Replica Decoys are removed by successful Discover, a successful Attack, or prohibited Silhouette contact; revealing the real user removes the remaining replicas.
requirements: The Trooper has the Decoy Special Skill.
restrictions: A Trooper using Decoy cannot remain part of a Fireteam or participate in a Coordinated Order.
The real user is revealed by the State's listed revealing declarations, failed deployment Rolls, enemy Silhouette contact, or forced Saving Rolls.

records.name: Impersonation-1 State
records.summary: The stronger Impersonation Marker State, which represents the user as an apparent ally and requires a penalized Discover Roll to reduce.

effects: The Model is replaced by an IMP-1 Marker and enemies perceive it as Allied.
A normal successful Discover Roll against IMP-1 applies the State's WIP -3 MOD and changes the user to Impersonation-2 State.
requirements: The Trooper can activate Impersonation-1 State through Impersonation or another qualifying rule.
restrictions: Attacks and Intuitive Attacks cannot be declared against an IMP-1 Marker under the normal Impersonation rules.
A Trooper in Impersonation State cannot be part of a Fireteam.

records.name: Impersonation-2 State
records.summary: The second Impersonation Marker State, which still disguises the user but is removed by a successful unmodified Discover Roll.

effects: The Model is replaced by an IMP-2 Marker and enemies perceive it as Allied.
A successful Discover Roll removes IMP-2 and replaces the Marker with the corresponding Model.
requirements: The Trooper can activate Impersonation-2 State through Impersonation or another qualifying rule.
restrictions: Attacks and Intuitive Attacks cannot normally be declared against an IMP-2 Marker until it is Discovered.
A Trooper in Impersonation State cannot be part of a Fireteam.

records.name: Foxhole State
records.summary: A fixed fortified State that changes the user's Silhouette, grants all-round Partial Cover and Mimetism, and prevents movement while active.

effects: The user's Silhouette becomes S3 unless their profile Silhouette is higher.
The user has Partial Cover in a 360-degree arc and gains Mimetism (-3) and Courage while the State is active.
The user cannot perform movement while Foxhole State remains active.
requirements: Foxhole State is entered through Sapper and requires space for the State's Silhouette.
restrictions: Entering Prone State cancels Foxhole State.
In the Active Turn, declaring a Movement-labelled Skill or beginning a Dodge move can cancel Foxhole State before that movement.

records.name: Berserk
records.summary: A Long CC Special Skill that combines an extended Move with a CC Attack against a visible target.

requirements: The target must be inside the user's Line of Fire when Berserk is declared.
effects: The user declares Move and CC Attack as one Long Skill and may move up to the sum of both MOV values to reach Silhouette contact with the target.
If the target cannot be reached, the declaration becomes Idle and neither the Move nor the CC Attack is performed.
A Berserk MOD shown in the Unit Profile applies to the CC Attack.
restrictions: The user declares the movement route and CC Attack target before ARO declarations.

records.name: Guard
records.summary: An Automatic CC Special Skill that lets the user make a CC Attack against a target in Line of Fire and Zone of Control without Silhouette contact.

requirements: The CC Attack target must be inside the user’s Line of Fire and Zone of Control.
effects: The user may perform a CC Attack without reaching or being in Silhouette contact with the target.
The user and target may apply Skills and MODs whose normal requirements include Silhouette contact.
restrictions: Guard cannot be used against an active Aerial Trooper unless that Trooper is Unconscious.

records.name: Neurocinetics
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill that shifts BS Weapon Burst from the Active Turn to the Reactive Turn.

effects: During the Active Turn, the Burst of all the user’s BS Weapons is reduced to 1.
During the Reactive Turn, the user may apply each BS Weapon’s full Burst against a single target.
Burst MODs apply in the Reactive Turn instead of the Active Turn.

records.name: Total Reaction
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill that lets BS Attack AROs use a weapon’s full Burst against one activated target.

effects: When declaring a BS Attack ARO, the user may apply the full Burst of the selected weapon, including Burst MODs.
restrictions: The ARO must target one of the Troopers activated by the Order.

records.name: Triangulated Fire
records.summary: A Long Attack Skill that performs a BS Attack without applying Roll MODs other than Burst MODs.

requirements: The user must have Line of Fire to the target.
effects: The user performs a BS Attack without applying Range, Cover, or Special Skill MODs to the Roll.
Burst MODs are still applied normally.
restrictions: The attack cannot target beyond the selected weapon’s Maximum Range.

records.name: Aerial
records.summary: An obligatory Automatic Special Skill representing a Trooper whose flight prevents normal contact and several ground-based interactions.

effects: While Aerial is active, the user is never in Silhouette contact with other Models, Objectives, scenery items, or game elements, even if physically touching them.
restrictions: While Aerial is active, the user cannot be in Prone State or Engaged State.
The user cannot declare Cautious Movement.
Guard cannot be used against the user unless the user is Unconscious.
Weapons with the Boost Trait do not activate against the user.

records.name: Climbing Plus
records.summary: An optional Automatic Movement Special Skill that makes Climb faster to declare and extends normal movement actions onto vertical surfaces.

requirements: At the end of the movement, the user must be able to place itself on a surface at least as large as its base.
effects: If declared as the first Basic Short Skill of the Order, Climb is treated as a Basic Short Skill instead of a Long Skill.
The user may move on vertical surfaces as though they were horizontal while declaring Move or Dodge, and while moving because of a failed Guts Roll.
The user may declare other compatible Basic Short Skills or Short Skills while moving on a vertical surface or hanging from a height.
During the Reactive Turn, the user may declare an ARO while on a vertical surface when otherwise permitted.
restrictions: Climb can be declared as a Basic Short Skill only once per Order; a following Move uses the second MOV value.
The user cannot benefit from Partial Cover MODs while on a vertical surface.
Troopers cannot deploy on vertical surfaces during the Deployment Phase or during the game.

records.name: Terrain
records.summary: An optional Automatic Special Skill that improves movement in one matching Terrain Type, or every Terrain Type with Terrain (Total).

requirements: The Terrain area must match a Terrain Type listed by the user’s Terrain Special Skill.
effects: When declaring a Skill with the Movement Label inside a matching Terrain area, the user gains +1 inch to the first value of its MOV Attribute.
The user may move normally through matching Terrain areas without applying that Terrain area’s movement restrictions.
If several Terrain Types are listed, the player chooses one when placing the Trooper on the game table.
Terrain (Total) applies these effects to every Terrain Type defined by the rules.

records.name: Warhorse
records.summary: An optional Automatic Special Skill that keeps the user operational through Loss of Lieutenant, Retreat, Isolation, and certain BS Attack penalties.

effects: The user is not affected by Loss of Lieutenant and remains Regular.
The user is not affected by Retreat, remains Regular, and does not enter Retreat State.
The user cannot enter Isolated State.
BS Attack (-X) Special Skill MODs have no effect against the user.

records.name: Courage
records.summary: An optional Automatic Special Skill that lets the user choose to automatically pass Guts Rolls and remain operational during Retreat.

effects: The user may choose to automatically pass any Guts Roll.
The user is unaffected by Retreat situations, cannot enter Retreat State, and acts normally until the end of the game.
restrictions: The user is still affected by Loss of Lieutenant, including during Retreat.

records.name: Frenzy
records.summary: An obligatory Automatic Special Skill that, after the user directly wounds or kills an enemy, grants Impetuous and Limited Cover and removes Marker States.

requirements: The user must directly inflict at least one Wound on an Enemy Trooper or cause that Trooper to enter Dead State.
effects: In the States Phase of the Player Turn where the Requirement is met, the user gains Impetuous and Limited Cover and retains them for the remainder of the game.
When the user gains Impetuous through Frenzy, they cancel any Marker State they are in and cannot re-enter those States.
restrictions: Wounds caused by the user’s Deployable Weapons do not satisfy the Requirement.

records.name: Impetuous
records.summary: An obligatory Automatic Special Skill that grants one activation in the Impetuous Phase while tightly constraining its legal Skill combinations and movement.

effects: During the Tactical Phase, place an Impetuous Token next to the user; during the Impetuous Phase the user may activate once by removing that Token without spending an Order.
An Impetuous activation follows the normal Order Expenditure Sequence and permits only the Skill combinations listed by the rule.
Movement-labelled Skills declared in the Impetuous Phase must follow the rule’s mandatory movement priorities and normally use the full corresponding MOV value.
restrictions: In the Impetuous Phase, Move, Jump, or Climb cancels Prone State and the user cannot enter Prone State at the end of the movement.
Impetuous Troopers cannot enter Marker States or any other States that explicitly prohibit entry.
A player in Retreat does not carry out the Impetuous Phase.

records.name: Religious Troop
records.summary: An obligatory Automatic Special Skill that automatically passes Guts Rolls while allowing a WIP Roll to apply failed-Guts movement, and ignores Retreat.

effects: The user automatically passes Guts Rolls and therefore normally holds position after surviving an Attack.
The user may instead make a WIP Roll; on success, they may apply the effects of failing the Guts Roll.
The user is unaffected by Retreat situations, does not enter Retreat State, and acts normally until the end of the game.
restrictions: During Retreat, the user cannot voluntarily leave the game table unless scenario rules allow it.
The user remains affected by Loss of Lieutenant, including during Retreat.

records.name: Dead State
records.summary: An irreversible Null State entered after a Trooper receives more Wounds than its VITA or STR value.

effects: The Trooper is removed from the game table and its Combat Group.
The Trooper no longer generates Orders and does not count toward Victory Points.
requirements: The Trooper has received more Wounds than its VITA or STR value, including receiving further Wounds while Unconscious.
restrictions: Dead State is irreversible unless a mission or scenario rule explicitly provides a cancellation procedure.

records.name: Engaged State
records.summary: A close-combat State entered through Silhouette contact with an eligible enemy Trooper.

effects: The Trooper is considered to be in Close Combat.
The Trooper may only declare Berserk, CC Attack, Dodge, Idle, Reset, or Skills that explicitly allow use in Close Combat or Engaged State.
The Trooper cannot draw Line of Fire outside its Close Combat.
requirements: The Trooper is in Silhouette contact with an enemy and neither Trooper is Immobilized or in a Null State, except Sepsitorized or Possessed.

records.name: Holoecho State
records.summary: A Marker State created by Holoprojector that conceals which of up to three representations is the real bearer.

effects: The bearer is represented together with holographic decoys and the player records which representation is real as Private Information.
The bearer and Holoechoes act together when the bearer is activated.
Enemies must Discover the relevant representation to reveal the bearer without another cancellation condition.
requirements: Holoprojector places or restores the Holoechoes under the deployment, States Phase, or Active Turn conditions specified by the rule.
restrictions: Holoecho State is canceled by its listed revelation and coherency conditions, including declarations or events that reveal the bearer.

records.name: HoloMask State
records.summary: A disguise State that represents the bearer as another same-faction Trooper while retaining the bearer’s real profile.

effects: The bearer is represented by an imitated same-faction or same-Sectorial Trooper with the same Silhouette value.
The bearer continues to use its real Unit Profile.
A successful Discover replaces the imitated Model with the real Model.
requirements: The imitated Trooper must belong to the bearer’s faction or Sectorial Army and have the same Silhouette value.
restrictions: HoloMask cannot copy Hacker or Hackable status or Deployable items represented by Tokens or Models.
The State is canceled by its listed revelation conditions.

records.name: Normal State
records.summary: The default State for Troopers and game elements unless another rule specifies otherwise.

effects: The Trooper normally generates an Order during the Tactical Phase.
The Trooper counts toward its player’s Victory Points.
requirements: Troopers normally deploy in this State and return to it when their Null State is canceled unless another rule applies.
restrictions: Normal State is canceled when the Trooper enters a Null State or another rule explicitly says so.

records.name: Prone State
records.summary: A posture State that changes Silhouette and halves Movement-labelled movement while active.

effects: The Trooper uses Silhouette X, matching the height and width of its base.
Movement from Skills with the Movement Label and failed Guts Rolls is halved while Prone.
requirements: A Trooper may deploy Prone or change between Normal and Prone at the permitted points of Movement-labelled Skills or AROs; eligible Troopers also become Prone when entering Unconscious State.
restrictions: Jump cancels Prone State, and some troop types or Equipment cannot enter Prone State.

records.name: Possessed State
records.summary: A Null State in which control of the affected Trooper passes to the opposing player and the Possessed profile is used.

effects: The owning player cannot activate the Trooper or give it Orders from the owner’s Order Pool.
The opposing player that caused the State may activate it through that Trooper’s Combat Group, using the Possessed profile.
The Trooper contributes no Orders, counts for neither player’s Victory Points, and cannot belong to a Fireteam.
requirements: A successful Attack, Effect, Hacking Program, scenario rule, or other game condition capable of causing Possessed State affects the Trooper.
restrictions: The owning player may cancel Possessed State with a Command Token in the specified Tactical Phase step, and Total Control can also cancel it.

records.name: Retreat! State
records.summary: A State applied when an army enters Retreat! that restricts declarations and cancels Marker and holographic States.

effects: The Trooper may only use Basic Short Skills, Cautious Movement, Dodge, Reset, or Special Skills that explicitly permit use in Retreat!.
Entering Retreat! cancels Holoprojector/HoloMask presentation and Marker States.
requirements: The Trooper’s army enters the Retreat! situation at the beginning of the Player Turn.
restrictions: Troopers protected by Courage, Religious Troop, Warhorse, or another applicable rule do not enter Retreat! State.

records.name: Sepsitorized State
records.summary: A Null State caused by a failed Saving Roll against Sepsitor that transfers practical control of the Trooper to the opposing player.

effects: The Trooper leaves its original Combat Group and cannot receive Orders from its owner.
The opposing player that caused the State may activate the Trooper through that Trooper’s Combat Group.
The Trooper contributes no Orders, counts for neither player’s Victory Points, and cannot belong to a Fireteam.
requirements: A Cube-wearing Trooper fails a Saving Roll against a Sepsitor Attack.

records.name: Suppressive Fire State
records.summary: A combat State entered through the Suppressive Fire Skill that uses the weapon’s SF Mode and penalizes nearby enemy Face to Face Rolls.

effects: Enemies within 24 inches apply a -3 MOD to their Attribute in Face to Face Rolls against the Trooper.
The selected weapon uses its Suppressive Fire Mode and may react in ARO with the full B3 against one target.
requirements: The Trooper declared the Suppressive Fire Long Skill.
restrictions: The State is canceled by the listed Order, ARO, weapon, Guts Roll, State, Loss of Lieutenant, or Fireteam conditions.

records.name: Dogged
records.summary: An optional Automatic Special Skill that lets an Unconscious Trooper keep acting temporarily before entering Dead State.

requirements: The user must enter Unconscious State and declare Dogged immediately, in either the Active or Reactive Turn.
effects: While Dogged is active, ignore the effects and Null Label of Unconscious State and treat the Trooper as being in Normal State for the rest of that Player Turn.
In the States Phase of that Player Turn, the Trooper automatically enters Dead State.
If the Trooper receives another Wound while Dogged is active, it enters Dead State directly.
A Remote Presence Trooper with STR may activate Dogged when entering any level of Unconscious State.
restrictions: Once Dogged is activated, the Trooper cannot be healed.
A Remote Presence Trooper cannot activate Dogged merely because it was already in Unconscious State before the triggering event.

records.name: No Wound Incapacitation
records.summary: An optional Automatic Special Skill that lets an Unconscious Trooper ignore that State's normal restrictions while remaining healable.

requirements: The user must enter Unconscious State and declare No Wound Incapacitation immediately, in either the Active or Reactive Turn.
effects: While active, ignore the effects and Null Label of Unconscious State and treat the Trooper as being in Normal State.
The user can be healed; removing one Wound returns it to Normal State and removes the NWI Token.
A Remote Presence Trooper with STR may activate No Wound Incapacitation when entering any level of Unconscious State.
A user that also has Doctor or Engineer may use that Skill on itself, applying the corresponding Effects.
restrictions: If the user receives another Wound, it enters Dead State directly.
If a Roll to heal the user fails, it enters Dead State directly.
A Remote Presence Trooper cannot activate No Wound Incapacitation merely because it was already in Unconscious State before the triggering event.

records.name: Remote Presence
records.summary: An obligatory Automatic Special Skill for STR Troopers that adds a second Unconscious level and changes repair behavior.

effects: A Remote Presence Trooper with STR has two distinct levels of Unconscious State before entering Dead State.
From either Unconscious level, one successful Engineer WIP Roll or GizmoKit PH Roll removes all Wounds necessary to cancel Unconscious State.
When Engineer or another rule explicitly permits it, Command Tokens may reroll the failed repair Roll.
Remote Presence remains active while its owner is in a Null State.
restrictions: The second Unconscious level applies to Troopers with both Remote Presence and the STR Attribute.

records.name: Shasvastii
records.summary: An obligatory Automatic Special Skill that changes how a Shasvastii Trooper's Unconscious State counts for Victory Point conditions during the game.

requirements: The user must enter Unconscious State and activate Shasvastii immediately, in either the Active or Reactive Turn.
effects: While the Shasvastii-Embryo form is active, the Unconscious Trooper still counts when calculating Victory Points for Retreat and other scenario rules or conditions.
At the end of the game, these special Unconscious rules end and the Trooper no longer counts when calculating Victory Points.

records.name: Regeneration
records.summary: An optional States Phase Automatic Special Skill that makes a PH Roll to remove a Wound, potentially cancelling Unconscious State.

effects: During the States Phase, the user makes a Normal PH Roll.
On success, remove one Wound and cancel Unconscious State if applicable.
On failure, the user receives one additional Wound.
Regeneration remains active while its owner is in a Null State.

records.name: Protheion
records.summary: An optional Automatic CC Special Skill that converts Wounds inflicted in Close Combat into recovered Wounds or temporary VITA increases.

requirements: The user must be in Silhouette contact with a target that has VITA and declare a CC Attack.
effects: For each Wound inflicted on the target by the user's CC Attack, or each Coup de Grâce performed, remove one Wound the user has received.
If the user has no Wounds to remove, remaining eligible Wounds increase VITA by one each, to a maximum of two points above the original value.
When Wounds are inflicted both by and on the user in the same Order, Protheion recovery and VITA increases are resolved before Wounds inflicted on the user.
restrictions: VITA can be increased by at most two points above the user's original value.

records.name: Loss of Lieutenant
records.summary: An army-level situation declared when the active player lacks an operational deployed Lieutenant during the Tactical Phase.

requirements: During the Tactical Phase, the active player has no deployed Lieutenant because the Lieutenant is absent, Isolated, or in a Null State.
effects: All Troopers in the Army List are Irregular while the Loss of Lieutenant situation applies.
At the end of the Turn, the player appoints a new eligible Lieutenant at no cost, canceling the situation.
restrictions: Troopers with Irregular Training or the REM Troop Type cannot be appointed as the replacement Lieutenant.

records.name: Special Lieutenant Order
records.summary: A special Order generated for the Lieutenant and kept separate from the Combat Group Order Pool for the Lieutenant's own use.

effects: The Order is kept separate from the Order Pool for the Lieutenant's own use.
Its status and expenditure are Open Information.
restrictions: The Special Lieutenant Order is not part of an Order Pool.

records.name: Tactical Order
records.summary: A special Order kept by the Trooper that generates it, usable by that Trooper and by applicable advanced rules such as Fireteams.

effects: A Tactical Order is kept by the Trooper that generates it for that Trooper's own use.
Applicable advanced rules may allow the Tactical Order to activate a Fireteam.
restrictions: A Tactical Order is not added to an Order Pool.

records.name: Command Token: Strategic Use
records.summary: The Strategic Use mode of Command Tokens, covering first-turn procedural effects and the Speedball logistical option.

effects: Strategic Use can alter Deployment, remove Regular Orders, limit enemy Command Token use, place a Trooper into Suppressive Fire State, or grant Speedball Tokens according to the selected option.
restrictions: Each player may spend at most two Command Tokens for Strategic Use: one Procedural option and one Logistical option.

records.name: Chain of Command
records.summary: An optional private Automatic Special Skill that appoints its user as the new Lieutenant when the current Lieutenant is unavailable during the Loss of Lieutenant check.

requirements: Use only at the start of the player's Loss of Lieutenant check.
The current Lieutenant must be Isolated or in a Null State.
The user must be on the table as a Model or Marker and cannot be Isolated or in a Null State.
effects: The user becomes the new Lieutenant and gains the Lieutenant Special Skill with no additional abilities.
The Loss of Lieutenant check is successful for the Turn.
restrictions: Chain of Command (Non Specialist) does not grant Specialist Troop status in scenarios where ordinary Chain of Command would do so.

records.name: Counterintelligence
records.summary: An optional private Automatic Special Skill that reduces the opponent's first-turn Command Token Strategic Use effects.

effects: Reduce to one the number of Orders the adversary can nullify with Strategic Use of a Command Token.
Alternatively, increase to two the number of Command Tokens the adversary may use when Strategic Use would otherwise limit them to one.

records.name: Inspiring Leadership
records.summary: An obligatory Automatic Special Skill that, while its user is the active Lieutenant, grants army-wide Training and Courage effects plus command benefits.

effects: If the user is Lieutenant, on the table, and not in a Null State, all Order-providing Troopers gain Regular Training and Courage except that Religious Troop does not receive the granted Courage effect.
The Special Lieutenant Order may be used to declare a Coordinated Order including the user without the normal Command Token or extra Order expenditure.
The army is unaffected by Retreat! while the active Lieutenant conditions are met.
A qualifying all-Regular Fireteam containing the user receives a +2 inch Team Leader Zone of Control bonus for Coherency Checks.
restrictions: The Fireteam Coherency bonus is not cumulative with another Team Leader Zone of Control bonus.

records.name: Lieutenant
records.summary: An obligatory private Automatic Special Skill identifying the army's commanding officer and granting the Special Lieutenant Order.

effects: The user has a Special Lieutenant Order.
If the Lieutenant is absent from the table, Isolated, or in a Null State during the Tactical Phase, Loss of Lieutenant applies.
The Lieutenant Skill remains active while its owner is in a Null State until a new Lieutenant is appointed.
restrictions: An Army List must include exactly one Lieutenant.
Irregular Troops and REM Troop Types cannot be chosen as Lieutenant.

records.name: Mnemonica
records.summary: An optional Automatic Special Skill that transfers the user's WIP, Mnemonica, and any Lieutenant status to an eligible allied host when the user enters a Null State.

requirements: The user must enter a Null State.
The chosen allied host must be on the battlefield as a Model or Marker and have either a Cube or the REM Troop Type.
effects: Transfer the user's WIP value and Mnemonica to the chosen host; if the user was Lieutenant, transfer Lieutenant and its additional abilities as well.
The transfer completes automatically at the end of the Order in which the user entered the Null State.
After the transfer, the original user enters Dead State and is removed from the game table.
restrictions: Troopers with Mnemonica are never considered to have a Cube.

records.name: NCO
records.summary: An optional Automatic Special Skill that converts Special Lieutenant Orders into Tactical Orders for the NCO to use.

effects: Replace any Special Lieutenant Orders with Tactical Orders and use them.
The NCO and Lieutenant do not need to be in the same Combat Group.
An NCO acting as Fireteam Team Leader may use the resulting Tactical Order to activate the Fireteam.
restrictions: An Isolated NCO cannot replace Special Lieutenant Orders or use the resulting Tactical Orders.

records.name: Tactical Awareness
records.summary: An optional Automatic Special Skill that grants its user an additional Tactical Order.

effects: The user gains a Tactical Order in addition to the Order provided by Training.
Place the Tactical Order during Order Count when the user is on the table as a Model or Marker, or when the user is placed on the table during the Orders Phase.
A user acting as Fireteam Team Leader may spend this Tactical Order to activate the Fireteam.

records.name: Paramedic
records.summary: An obligatory Automatic Special Skill that equips the user with a MediKit for recovering Unconscious allies.
